verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs describe a scriptable command-line install through its first-party Homebrew tap, which is the closest thing to a documented silent install for the Mac client. There is no evidence of MSI or MDM packages, managed preferences, or any way to preset configuration across a fleet. Pairing is per-device, by QR code or USB. Missing for 10: MDM/managed-configuration support, preset configuration (e.g., pre-seeded settings or pairing), enterprise packaging (PKG/MSI), fleet deployment documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install

citations.quote: brew install --cask saffsanity/sill/sill in Terminal installs the same Sill.dmg from Sill’s own tap. To update it, quit Sill and run brew upgrade --cask sill.
